parsed.rationale: All four records are empty `interface` (protocol) declarations with `shared_field_count: 2` and no differing slots, meaning they are structurally identical marker protocols. A canonical `AnalyticsEvent` protocol already exists in the dedicated `Analytics` package at `Shared/Analytics/Sources/Analytics/AnalyticsEvent.swift`. The domain-specific variants — `PlaybackAnalyticsEvent` (package `Playback`), `QualityAnalyticsEvent` (package `Wallpaper`), and `RequestLineAnalyticsEvent` (package `MusicShareKit`) — should inherit from `AnalyticsEvent` rather than independently redeclaring the same shape. This preserves domain namespacing while eliminating the structural duplication and enabling cross-package analytics consumers to program against the common parent.
